zh.title: 一个 Agent，为什么需要多个 Session？
zh.lead: 切换三种组织方式，观察跨渠道连续性与并发执行如何相互制约。
zh.diagramLabel: 三种会话架构的任务分配图
zh.map1: 隔离 Worker + 异步工具
zh.map3: 三者分离 + 外部 Watchdog
zh.entryText: IM：修复登录 → CI：登录测试失败 → PR：改用方案 B
zh.singleCoord: 同一 Session 协调并执行
zh.singleWork: 登录任务、CI 调查、独立文档任务的细节混在同一窗口，推理逐步串行。
zh.isolatedCoord: 每个事件独立接收、独立回复
zh.isolatedWork:
Session A：登录请求
Session B：CI 反馈
Session C：方案 B
缺少默认共享的任务关联。
zh.twoCoord: Router：关联任务、派发、统一交互；不亲自执行耗时任务。
zh.twoWork:
Worker A：登录任务，接收相关 CI / PR
Worker B：独立文档任务
上下文隔离，任务可并发推进。
zh.event2: ↳ PR 修改同一个任务的方向
zh.caption: 统一身份由系统维护；Session 是执行细节，不必成为用户的项目管理单位。
zh.limit0: 图是架构责任模型，不是计时基准；未模拟模型准确率。
zh.limit1: Router 层与 Worker 层都是逻辑角色；任一层内部都可能不止一个 Session。
zh.limit2: Agent Team 通常拆解同一复杂任务；这里的 Router 主要派发独立任务，Worker 内部仍可使用 Team。
zh.question: 为什么“给主 Session 一个 subagent 工具”还不等于双层架构？
zh.answer: 主 Session 仍可选择自己执行；双层架构把协调与执行的职责分开。工具可用性不等于稳定的职责约束。
zh.step0Explanation: 四个目标由多种机制共同支持。点击架构按钮，比较同一输入如何进入上下文。
zh.step1Explanation: 同一 PR 的 CI 和评论可能属于已有任务；独立文档工作则应分开执行。
zh.step2Title: 跨渠道仍需保持任务关联
zh.step2Explanation: 方案 B 必须到达正在处理登录任务的执行者。上下文连续性与并发都需要系统维护。
zh.context3: A · PR 改为方案 B
zh.dispatch: ↓ 关联并派发到任务上下文
zh.separateEntries: ↓ 各事件进入各自窗口，缺少默认关联
zh.sameWindow: ↓ 协调和执行共用同一窗口

en.title: Why does one agent need several sessions?
en.lead: Switch between three designs to inspect continuity across channels and concurrency across tasks.
en.diagramLabel: Task placement in three session architectures
en.entryText: IM: fix login → CI: login test fails → PR: use plan B
en.singleCoord: The same session coordinates and executes
en.singleWork: Login, CI investigation, and an independent docs task share one context; inference proceeds serially.
en.isolatedCoord: Each event is received and answered separately
en.isolatedWork:
Session A: login request
Session B: CI feedback
Session C: plan B
Task relations are not shared by default.
en.twoCoord: Router: relate tasks, dispatch, and communicate; do not execute long tasks.
en.twoWork:
Worker A: login work, with related CI / PR inputs
Worker B: independent docs work
Isolated contexts let tasks progress concurrently.
en.caption: The system maintains one identity. Execution sessions need not be the user’s unit of project management.
en.limit0: This is a responsibility model, not a timing benchmark or an accuracy simulation.
en.limit1: Both layers are logical roles. Either may contain more than one session.
en.limit2: An Agent Team often decomposes one complex task. This Router dispatches separate tasks; a Worker can contain a Team.
en.question: Why does adding a subagent tool not guarantee a two-level architecture?
en.answer: The main session can still choose to execute work itself. Separating responsibilities constrains that choice; tool availability alone does not.
en.step0Explanation: Several mechanisms support the four goals. Switch the architecture to compare where the same inputs go.
en.step1Title: A new event need not be a new task
en.step1Explanation: CI and comments on the same PR may belong to existing work; independent docs work needs a separate execution context.
en.step2Explanation: Plan B must reach the executor of the login task. The system must preserve relations while allowing concurrency.
en.context3: A · PR changes to plan B
en.dispatch: ↓ Relate and dispatch to task contexts
en.separateEntries: ↓ Each event enters its own window, without default relations
en.sameWindow: ↓ Coordination and execution share one window
